title: Financial Institution Financing Sales - VP
description: Financial Institution Financing Sales - VP Financial Markets is part of the ING Wholesale Bank, which represents all Corporate and Investment Banking activities of ING. We have a global footprint with local reach, deep sector expertise and we play a pivotal role in areas of sustainability and innovation. FM is the bank’s gateway to the professional markets around the world. In short, we assist our clients with investment and hedging risks by means of derivatives and we distribute bonds, loans, and equities towards investors. The client related business is supported by Trading, Structuring and Research expertise. Our main goal is to help our clients navigate the markets to position them for consistent and stable growth. Department Overview: Institutional Sales within Financial Markets provide both flow and bespoke financial solutions to clients. We are functionally structured to reflect the differing needs of our clients. This is enhanced with the specialist non-flow service from the Client Solutions Group. We transact and offer client solutions in a broad range of products including (among others) foreign exchange, interest rate derivatives, money markets, financing, primary and secondary fixed income and structured products. This structure enhances cross-selling, improves the flow of market/product information and aims to deepen client relationships through a platform capable of delivering a variety of products to a diverse client base. Our local footprint of circa 300 salespeople across 28 locations, ensures that sales teams are in close proximity to our clients, delivering global expertise with local insight. Main Duties and Responsibilities of Role: A public side financial market sales role focused on delivering Financing (Repo, Money Markets, broader financing such as securitised/structured products) to financial institutions in the UK, MENA and Switzerland. Sales coverage of existing clients, expansion of the Financing client base, and business growth in cooperation with colleagues across the European locations and globally. Active support to other London Salespeople Close collaboration with the eSales colleagues ranging from strategy to the transactional level FI clients include both hedgers and investors, such as regional and private banks, financial sponsors, insurance companies, traditional and alternative strategy asset managers, Real Money, Hedge Funds etc Strong Financing knowledge is critical for this position with a sophisticated customer base using both voice and electronic dealing streams. The candidate will need to play an active role in marketing and execution of this business Expert understanding of price creation and validation for all vanilla and exotic Financing products Responsibility for day-to-day new client onboarding for the FI team, working closely with the relationship managers and the Front Office Support teams to get all requirements in place in a timely and efficient manner Ongoing monitoring to ensure all upcoming CDD/KYC/EMIR/MIFID/DF expiries and requirements are managed to prevent any down time in client dealing ability Work closely with colleagues in Trading to ensure we optimise our capabilities and risk appetite Experience or familiarity with trade execution through relevant voice and e-Systems. Outstanding ability to focus on core issues and attention to detail with swift execution in a fast-paced environment Proactive role in the constructive feedback loop, aiming to continuously improve ING’s tools, methods and way-of-working Partner with Client Solutions Group and Research in distributing their content, publications and trade ideas How to succeed We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. title: Praktikant Financial Market Sales (w/m/d)
description: Du hörst nie auf, neugierig zu sein, und willst jeden Tag dazulernen. Und das am liebsten von den Besten und mit den besten Aussichten. Du suchst die Herausforderung und möchtest endlich die Theorie Deines Studiums in die Praxis umsetzen. Genau das brauchst Du, um bei einem Praktikum bei uns richtig durchzustarten. Deine Aufgaben Du bist von Tag eins an direkt dabei und unterstützt unsere Profis bei der Betreuung deutscher und österreichischer Unternehmenskunden sowie institutioneller Kunden wie Banken, Fondsgesellschaften, Pensionskassen und Versicherungen. Du unterstützt aktiv die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Kapitalmarkttransaktionen (Anleiheemissionen). Risikomanagement und die Abwicklung von Handelsgeschäften sind dabei Deine größten Themen bei uns und Du analysierst mit neusten Analysetools das Geschäftstreiben. Du tauchst tief darin ein und kannst so Kundenbesuche sowie aktuelle Kapitalmarktthemen vor- und aufbereiten. Wenn Du Dich jetzt noch 1) für unser Produktspektrum aus Zins-, FX-, Rohstoff- und Aktien-Derivaten, Schuldscheinen sowie Anleihen in Primär- und Sekundärmarkt interessierst, 2) analysieren und präsentieren kannst und 3) gerne mit ING-Einheiten auf der ganzen Welt zusammenarbeiten möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Wir freuen uns auf Deinen Input! Dein Profil Immatrikuliert im Bachelor / Master in Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder im Gap Year zwischen Bachelor- und Master-Studium Nachweis über Kursbelegung in Finance mit Derivate Pricing-Bezug an der Hochschule Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Kapitalmarktprodukten und Bloomberg notwendig Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PowerPoint und Excel, insbesondere in der Erstellung professioneller Präsentation sowie der Analyse und Aufbereitung von Datensätzen Leidenschaft für die Entwicklungen an den Finanzmärkten Organisationstalent, hohe Leistungsbereitschaft & Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit & Sorgfalt Kommunikativer Teamplayer mit hoher Kundenorientierung Willen, die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch sind ein Muss Verfügbar für 6 Monate ab Oktober 2026 (bitte gib den genauen Zeitraum inkl. Startdatum im Anschreiben an) Freu Dich auf zahlreiche Benefits Ansprechende Vergütung, kostenloses Deutschlandticket, 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebsrestaurant Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe in einer Du-Kultur Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Zusätzlich zur Arbeit im Büro kannst Du auch mobil arbeiten – im Rahmen betrieblicher, gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen. Löwenstarke Netzwerkangebote, persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie vielfältige Angebote zu Bewegung, Vorsorge, Ernährung und Balance Lust auf einen neuen Job? Bei der ING sind wir bunt und vielfältig: unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten mit verschiedenen Perspektiven - in einer internationalen Kultur, in der wir uns wertschätzen. title: Financial Risk Specialist – Market & Liquidity Risk Management (w/m/d)
description: You feel at home in capital markets and thrive in intelligent risk management as well as quantitative analyses? Do you want to support our decision making using state-of-the-art models and data while working in an international and agile environment? Is a corporate culture that encourages personal responsibility, rewards performance and offers opportunities for continuous development right up your alley? Then apply now with your CV – your team is excited to meet you. Your Tasks You analyse and quantify market and liquidity risks across all our business activities – from Retail and Wholesale Banking to Group Treasury – and create the foundation for sound decisions in a dynamic market environment. You help us in modelling our client products and analysing customer behaviour, e. g. regarding prepayment rights in mortgage financing. Here, you critically question assumptions and methods, evaluate their impact on our risk profile, and contribute to the further development of our risk measurement and monitoring. You diligently assess interest rate risks as well as the suitability of hedging strategies and derivative investments. Through scenario analyses, stress tests and the critical review of models and assumptions, you play a key part in our independent risk monitoring. Of course, you always keep a close eye on market developments and support us in taking the right steps in challenging situations. As a part of the Second Line of Defence, you advise and challenge the First LoD, evaluate risk-relevant decisions and monitor compliance with market and liquidity risk limits. Your judgement ensures an equal assessment of opportunities and risks. Teamwork is key to success: You collaborate closely with colleagues from across the bank as well as the Head Office, develop group-wide standards and put them into practice. Your Profile Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Physics or a similar qualification Professional experience in a comparable position combined with strong capital markets expertise Ideally, experience in analysing and evaluating large data sets Excellent Python skills Ability to communicate complex topics clearly and tailor them to target audiences Analytical mindset, initiative and creativity Open to cultural diversity in an international environment Very good German and English, both written and spoken We offer many benefits Company pension plan, capital-building offers, free Deutschlandticket & bicycle leasING, company restaurant Hybrid working: In addition to working in the office, you can also work remotely – within operational, regulatory and legal requirements. Individualized work schedule models, sabbatical, subsidization of nursing & childcare costs Personal budget for continuing education and development as well as health; plus, a personal budget to set up your mobile working space Ready for a new job? At ING we are colourful and diverse: different personalities with different perspectives - an international culture where we value and appreciate each other. We believe in substance over style, people instead of labels. This describes you to a T? Simply apply online - your resume is all we need to get to know you, a cover letter is optional!

description: This position is part of the Market Risk Management agile organisation (Tribe) within Product HO Market Risk Management. Working in an agile set-up, the Tribe manages market and counterparty risks at Group level through measurement, monitoring, reporting and control across all asset classes and entities. The team maintains regulatory frameworks and risk methodologies, supports relevant risk committees, and contributes to standards, implements all models and systems for market risk, valuation and counterparty risk management. Your role at RBI: Analyse outputs from daily risk measurement, stress testing and back testing across market risk types (e.g., FX, structural FX, interest rate, credit spread, equity option and correlation risks) for main HO portfolios. Monitor market risk limits (e.g., VaR, BPV, sensitivities, stop-loss) and document recommendations for handling limit breaches. Review market risk limit applications and contribute to risk appetite, limit frameworks, strategies and scenario design; discuss exposures and assumptions with stakeholders (e.g., traders, treasury, business units). Prepare regular and ad-hoc regulatory and management reporting (e.g., RWA analysis, back testing exceptions, prudent valuation, stress testing, portfolio analyses) and explain results to senior stakeholders and regulators where applicable. Support Network Banks on market risk topics (e.g., Basel IV, stress testing, FX and interest risk measurement, product introductions) and collaborate with internal/external partners such as auditors, regulators, local treasurers and risk teams. Contribute to new product approval by assessing market and counterparty risk implications and coordinating with model developers/analysts to integrate products into risk calculations and monitoring. Coordinate with partners across RBI (e.g., Credit Portfolio Management, Business Units, Treasury) to align inputs, resolve dependencies and deliver risk analyses. Take ownership of project work (projects, sub-projects or workstreams): define deliverables, manage stakeholders and track outcomes through to completion. Share knowledge within the team and support colleagues through coaching and peer review. Your core competencies: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree is a plus. Practical experience in market risk management, risk analytics or a comparable quantitative risk function (typical background 7–10 years) within a financial institution, consulting or a related environment. Working knowledge of financial instruments such as bonds, derivatives, options and structured products, and how their risks are measured and reported. Practical experience with market risk measures and methods (e.g., VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing, sensitivities/Greeks) and how they are applied to portfolios. Knowledge of regulatory market risk topics (e.g., FRTB, Standardised Approach, Open FX Risk) and ability to translate requirements into monitoring and reporting practices. Quantitative modelling and validation capability; experience using Python (or similar) for data analysis, automation and risk metric calculations. Interest in using automation and AI-enabled tools to improve risk monitoring, controls and reporting workflows.
